title: TRAM promotes Toll-like-receptor-free myddosome signal transduction.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Ran paper_context.py: no PMCID, no open full text, no supplement, no text-mined accessions. NCBI elink from PubMed 42778610 returned only related-PubMed links (no GEO, SRA or BioProject). GEO search 'TRAM myddosome' returned 0 series. Zenodo search on the DOI returned 0 records.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Everything else comes from the abstract alone: a genetic screen in macrophages, biochemistry, live-cell imaging, reconstitution with recombinant proteins, and inflammatory gene expression readouts. Screen size, hit table and any sequencing data were not visible.

a1_downloadable.note: No deposited dataset found: no open full text, no supplement, no GEO/SRA/BioProject link from PubMed, nothing on Zenodo. Checked via APIs, not the paper.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No table seen. The paper is mechanistic (imaging, biochemistry); any label, e.g. screen hit scores, is not visible anywhere.

a5_enough_rows.note: Row count unknown. Mechanistic experiments on a handful of proteins (TRAM, TIRAP, MyD88) give few independent examples.

a6_fits_laptop.note: Not testable without data; nothing suggests it would be large.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: No download to compare against the paper.

a8_label_provenance.note: No label identified, so provenance cannot be traced.

honest_claim_h3: No ML claim is possible: there is no accessible dataset, only a mechanistic study of how the TRAM protein releases MyD88 signalling complexes from Toll-like receptors.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use genome-wide macrophage screen results to predict which genes control how long inflammatory signalling lasts after immune-receptor activation.
plain_idea.train_on: Per-gene screen scores from the macrophage genetic screen, if they were released; number of genes unknown because no screen table was found.
plain_idea.predict: Whether knocking out a gene changes myddosome (an immune signalling protein complex) assembly, as measured by the authors' screen readout.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: It could point innate-immunity labs to new regulators of long-lasting inflammation, but without released screen data this cannot be built.

ml_idea: Considered: model the macrophage genetic-screen hit scores with gene embeddings to find more regulators of myddosome maturation. Not feasible because no screen table or other data is deposited or open.

effort.compute_note: No data found, so nothing to estimate.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Look for a deposited screen table or GEO series linked to PMID 42778610; done, none found.

verdict_reason: A1 fails: paywalled mechanistic cell-biology paper with no open full text, no supplement found, no GEO/SRA/BioProject link and no Zenodo record. The core work (imaging, biochemistry, reconstitution) does not produce a model-ready table anyway.
